name: Undamaged Venom Sac
summary: Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill wants a fresh sample of the venom already delivered, and sends you after the spiders that yield it in the Hinterlands. Time matters, since it must arrive fresh.

sections.title: A Fresh Sample
sections.body: After Venom Bottles, Apothecary Lydon asks for something fresher. The spiders that yielded the venom must live in the Hinterlands, and an undamaged venom sac is wanted from them. Many roam near the troll city of Shadra'Alor. There is no time to waste, because the sac has to be fresh on arrival. Lydon is eager to run experiments with it, and has ordered in several small, terribly cute animals to test it on.

faq.q: Who requests the undamaged venom sac?
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill asks for it and waits there for it.

faq.q: Where can the spiders be found?
aliases: where to find undamaged venom sac
faq.answer: In the Hinterlands, where many spiders are found near the troll city of Shadra'Alor.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Lydon say not to tarry?
faq.answer: Freshness is essential, so Lydon wants the sac delivered without delay.

aliases: what quest comes before undamaged venom sac
faq.answer: It follows Venom Bottles, in which a sample of venom from a Witherbark village was brought to Lydon.
